title: Kim & Cam's Taekwondo Academy

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: No school? No problem! Join us for fun-filled Day Camps packed with Taekwondo training, games, challenges, and creative activities to keep kids active and engaged all day. Campers will build confidence, improve focus, and burn off energy in a safe, structured environment led by our experienced instructors. These camps are perfect for students ages 6 and up of all levels. Day Camps are perfect for non-KC friends that you'd like to share your love for Taekwondo with! Special pricing for guests and siblings. Day Camps may qualify for the Child and Dependent Care Credit. Check with your tax professional for more info! services.name: Our Programs
services.desc: At KC Taekwondo, our classes are based on age and belt rank to ensure that everyone gets the individualized instruction they need. Our instructors leads fun, high-energy classes that emphasize crucial life skills such as confidence, respect, focus, and discipline. Our Tots program supports critical development designed specifically for the 3.5-5 age group. Basic martial arts training will help build balance, gross motor control, and hand-eye coordination. In addition to the physical benefits, students build positive social experiences, learn cooperation, listening skills, and so much more.
